description: The user's current weekly meal plan from their EINI account (lunch and dinner per day, built around this week's Swiss supermarket deals). Without 'day': the week overview. With 'day': that day's recipes with ingredients, quantities and steps. Needs the user's EINI login. If there is no plan yet, the answer says so.

day.description: Optional. Weekday in any language ('Monday', 'Montag', 'lundi', 'lunedì') or the day number 1-7 in the plan.

name: eini_my_meal_plan
title: My EINI meal plan
